title: Open-Less/openless
claim: Open-Less/openless — Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Win
why_good: The ability to seamlessly integrate AI-polished text generation into any application could significantly enhance productivity for users across various industries.
value: Businesses could pay for premium features or subscriptions that provide advanced customization, analytics, and integration with existing workflows.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if larger companies develop similar features and integrate them into their existing products.
